technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with RSI14 and MACD bullish, but price structure remains weak below key moving averages and cloud resistance, limiting swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: BBY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 27 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (435.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring discretionary consumer stocks, with earnings event in 27 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI14 and MACD bullish with supertrend confirmation plus extreme fear sentiment (22/100) creates contrarian entry near support (75.20), offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with negative CMF, weak ADX trend confirmation, VIX crisis (435.2), unfavorable macro (rising dollar, flat yield curve), and earnings binary risk in 27 days eliminate swing entry probability despite momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI14 and MACD bullish signals with extreme fear sentiment (22/100) create contrarian setup, but price structure remains critically weak below all major moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with negative CMF.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (435.2), unfavorable macro environment (rising dollar, flat yield curve recession signal), and binary earnings event in 27 days create unacceptable downside risk for swing trade timing.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
